patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff carries the correct source-side fix for this bug (`if (UNLIKELY(size >= helper->buffer->len)) return NULL;`) but `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` failed because the diff also contains a binary testcase hunk that `git apply` rejected without a full index line. Fixed-side verification therefore uses the authoritative `n132/arvo:14455-fix` image with the frozen fixed instrumentation patch applied on top.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First non-harness project statement on the vulnerable path that interprets the PROXY v2 header length and materializes the claimed header size used in later cursor arithmetic.

Incomplete bounds check. The parser validates the claimed PROXY v2 size only against `sizeof(*hdr)` and never compares it with the actual request extent `helper->buffer->len`, so a truncated 13-byte buffer survives with `size == 16`.

ASan sink. `memmem()` receives a start pointer at `data_copy + 16` and an underflowed search length derived from `helper->buffer->len - 16`, so the search span extends outside the logical request buffer and AddressSanitizer aborts with `negative-size-param (size=-3)`.

At the sanitizer sink `helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, "\r\n\r\n", 4);`, the second argument is the same underflowed `adjusted_size` computed at line 277, so `memmem()` receives the wrapped `size_t` search length that ASan reports as `negative-size-param (size=-3)`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace shows `proxy_v2_search_window.window_len == proxy_v2_memmem_sink.window_len == 18446744073709551613`.

edges.description: The unchecked claimed PROXY v2 size is the exact cursor offset after `buffer += size`, so the root-cause `size` value becomes the past-end search-start offset observed at the remaining-window computation.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `proxy_v2_guard.claimed_size == proxy_v2_search_window.start_offset == 16`.

edges.description: The wrapped `adjusted_size` produced by the negative remaining-span cast is passed unchanged from the local `adjusted_size` computation into the `memmem()` sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `proxy_v2_search_window.window_len == proxy_v2_memmem_sink.window_len == 18446744073709551613`.
